mapper.select:
SELECT DD.출고사업장 AS DD_DLIVYBPLC , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(DD.출고일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, DD.출고일자) , 126) ELSE DD.출고일자 END) AS DD_DLIVYDE , DD.출고일련번호 AS DD_DLIVYSN , RTRIM(DD.출고품목코드) AS DD_DLIVY_ICCODE , DD.수량 AS DD_QY , DD.구분 AS DD_SE , DD.출고단가 AS DD_DLIVYUNTPC , DD.출고금액 + DD.부가세금액 AS DD_DLIVYDETAIL_AM , DD.출고금액 AS DD_SPLPCAM , DD.부가세금액 AS DD_VAT_AM , COUNT(DD.출고일자) OVER (PARTITION BY DH.출고거래처, DD.출고일자) AS DD_CO , SUM(DD.출고수량) OVER (PARTITION BY DH.출고거래처, DD.출고일자) AS DD_QYSM , DD.비고 AS DD_RM , DH.총금액 AS DD_AM , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , RTRIM(IC.단위) AS IC_UNIT , RTRIM(CM.상호) AS CM_DLVYENTRPSNM , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , CM.생산 AS CM_PRDCTN
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DD.출고일자 ORDER BY RTRIM(CM.상호) DESC, DD.출고일자, RTRIM(IC.품목명)) AS GRP_DTNUMBER , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DD, 5, #{listStartDt}),112) AS listStartDt
ORDER BY RTRIM(CM.상호) DESC, DD.출고일자, RTRIM(IC.품목명)
mapper.sql:
FROM 출고머리 DH JOIN 출고상세 DD WITH(NOLOCK) ON (DH.출고사업장 = DD.출고사업장 AND DH.출고일자 = DD.출고일자 AND DH.출고일련번호 = DD.출고일련번호 )
JOIN 거래처MASTER CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON (DH.출고사업장 = CM.등록사업장 AND DH.출고거래처 = CM.거래처코드)
JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (DD.출고사업장 = IC.사업장 AND DD.출고품목코드 = IC.품목코드)
